requirements.statement: In each form, each label adjacent to a field other than a checkbox, a radio button or an element with role checkbox, radio or switch is placed visually immediately above the field, or immediately on the side where its language's reading starts: left for a left-to-right language, right for a right-to-left one.

citations.quote: Chaque étiquette accolée à un champ (à l’exception des cases à cocher, bouton radio ou balises ayant un attribut WAI-ARIA `role="checkbox"`, `role="radio"` ou `role="switch"`), vérifie-t-elle ces conditions (hors cas particuliers) ?

routes.statement: The label is visually adjacent immediately above the field, whatever the reading direction of its language.

citations.quote: L’étiquette est visuellement accolée immédiatement au-dessus ou à gauche du champ de formulaire lorsque le sens de lecture de la langue de l’étiquette est de gauche à droite ;
L’étiquette est visuellement accolée immédiatement au-dessus ou à droite du champ de formulaire lorsque le sens de lecture de la langue de l’étiquette est de droite à gauche.

routes.statement: The label's language reads from left to right, and the label is visually adjacent immediately to the left of the field.

citations.quote: à gauche du champ de formulaire lorsque le sens de lecture de la langue de l’étiquette est de gauche à droite

routes.statement: The label's language reads from right to left, and the label is visually adjacent immediately to the right of the field.

citations.quote: à droite du champ de formulaire lorsque le sens de lecture de la langue de l’étiquette est de droite à gauche.

exceptions.statement: The label mixes a portion of text read right to left with a portion read left to right; the test is then not applicable.

citations.quote: Dans le cas où l’étiquette mélange une portion de texte qui se lit de droite à gauche avec une portion de texte qui se lit de gauche à droite

exceptions.statement: The form holds labels in several languages, some read right to left and others left to right; the test is then not applicable.

citations.quote: Dans le cas où un formulaire contient des labels de plusieurs langues qui se liraient de droite à gauche et inversement.

exceptions.statement: The fields are used in a context where placing the labels differently can be legitimate from the point of view of user experience; the test is then not applicable.

citations.quote: Dans le cas où les champs seraient utilisés dans un contexte où il pourrait être légitime, du point de vue de l’expérience utilisateur, de placer les étiquettes de manière différente à celle requise dans les tests 11.4.2 et 11.4.3.

rationale.text: The wording has two conditions, one per reading direction. Each label reads in one direction only, so they are modelled as one requirement with three routes: above, whatever the direction; left, for a left-to-right language; right, for a right-to-left one. The particular cases make the test not applicable for a label that mixes directions, for a form with labels in languages of both directions, and for a context where another placement is legitimate for the user experience. That last exception decides the level. Any page whose label sits below or after its field may be such a context, and whether it is cannot be decided by code, so no fault can prove failure; and the routes require the label to be adjacent immediately, which is the judgment of test 11.4.1. The entry is none. The fourth particular case, about checkboxes and radio buttons not shown as such, concerns fields this test excludes, and is listed on test 11.4.3. One custom check is linked as evidence: for a native field in a form, with one visible <label> tied by for and id, it compares the two boxes and flags a label that is neither above nor on the starting side of its direction, taking the direction from the bidirectional class of the label's letters and abstaining on mixed labels or forms. It examines the three routes but neither the exceptions nor closeness, and only labels given by a <label> element, so its scope is partial and its fault is evidence only. The language of a label is read here from its script, which only approximates the reading direction of its language. No axe rule is tagged for this test. Applicability is judgment: the particular cases decide it. Needs is empty: positions are read on the page as loaded.

citations.quote: Les tests 11.4.2 et 11.4.3 seront considérés comme non applicables :
de placer les étiquettes de manière différente à celle requise dans les tests 11.4.2 et 11.4.3.
ne sont pas visuellement présentés sous forme de bouton radio ou de case à cocher
Il faut que l’étiquette et son champ soient visuellement proches
